text: 【深化资本市场投融资综合改革】近日召开的中央政治局会议提出，深化资本市场投融资综合改革，提升资本市场韧性和信心。这为当前及今后一个时期资本市场的高质量发展指明了方向，更在关键节点释放出强烈的稳预期信号。
text_en: [Deepen comprehensive reform of capital market investment and financing] The recent Politburo meeting proposed deepening comprehensive reform of capital market investment and financing to enhance market resilience and confidence. This points the way for high-quality capital market development now and in the period ahead, and sends a strong signal of stabilizing expectations at a critical juncture.
